displayIdentity.body: The scene includes noonday light, the voice of Jesus, and commission. It also includes nations, opened eyes, and darkness and light. It also includes Satan and God, repentance, and arrest. It also connects Paul’s witness with what Moses and the prophets said would happen. Together, these details appear in testimony.
